subject: Exclude standing harness drain tasks from the interactive heartbeat spawn pool
description:
The three standing harness drain tasks (followup/harness-judge-drain, -label-drain, -learner-drain) are owned by the daemon's headless drain runner (lib/headless-drain.js + daemon.js:2584 setInterval), which spawns headless claude -p children that call start_task with those keys directly. But the interactive heartbeat (next_action -> action:'spawn') ALSO sees them as spawnable: the ready[] pool at daemon.js:1210-1221 does not filter them, and isStandingHarnessTask() (lib/harness-task.js:11) is never imported into daemon.js. So an interactive agent/loop driving the heartbeat spawns a generic worker on them, colliding with the headless runner.

FIX (2 lines):
1. daemon.js top requires: const { isStandingHarnessTask } = require('./lib/harness-task');
2. daemon.js:1221 filter extended: && !isStandingHarnessTask(ov, t.id)

This leaves the tasks in 'ready' STATUS (so the headless runner's start_task CAS still succeeds) but removes them from the interactive spawn enumeration. Does NOT affect: headless drain runner (calls start_task directly), pressure-nudge path (/judge/pressure nudge text references keys explicitly), or /ready read endpoint (read-only display).

Triviality: single-file, 2-line filter clause. No judge needed.
